sample_scope: Heritage-park entrance package combining bilingual wayfinding, accessible slow movement, removable seating and seasonal shade.

dimension_template.method: Record surveyed values and reviewer decisions without inferring dimensions from generated visuals.

cost_estimation.method: Create a verified quantity takeoff for each removable component, multiply by dated and cited unit-rate sources, then add installation, traffic/access management, maintenance, removal, restoration, tax and contingency assumptions as separate lines.

maintenance_cycle.check: route clearance, fixing, sharp edges, shade stability, sign accuracy and emergency access
cleaning, damage, obstruction, legibility and accessibility
shade removal or adjustment, tree condition and drainage
close affected element, record event, repair or remove before reopening

emergency_escalation.action: Authorized site steward pauses use, secures the location, restores an ordinary accessible route, records the event and escalates to the relevant reviewer roles.
emergency_escalation.restart_authority: accountable site steward after documented reviewer clearance

exit_acceptance: inspect substrate, heritage and tree condition
archive photographs, measurements and reviewer acceptance
claim_boundary: This is a participant-authored handoff method. It is not a construction drawing, surveyed site record, permit, cost commitment, installation order or institutional approval.
